VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: SELF

The agent's self-report alone is insufficient to verify acceptance criteria satisfaction. While the agent claims to have fixed the off-by-one error and that "all 64 tests pass locally," there is no independent evidence (CI logs, test results, diffs, or artifacts) to corroborate these claims. Local test passage is not equivalent to verified acceptance criteria fulfillment, especially for a critical data integrity bug in a ledger reconciler where skipping records has serious consequences. Independent verification through CI/automated testing infrastructure is required.
